articles.title: Moody's says 'unprecedented' AI spending threatens credit quality of Amazon, Meta, Alphabet and others
articles.description: Moody's said AI spending is forcing even the world's most cash-rich corporations to lean heavily on debt, stock sales and off-balance-sheet moves.

articles.title: Trump vows to investigate EU over fining of US tech companies
articles.description: The US president says fines against Google, as well as Apple, Meta and Amazon, should be "entirely reversed."

articles.title: Bond market anxiety is growing over AI capex budgets
articles.description: Google, Amazon and Meta are seeing credit spreads widen as fixed-income investors demand more reward on companies they lend to.

articles.title: Trump threatens EU with 'substantial TARIFF' for 'ROBBING' U.S. tech giants
articles.description: Trump on Truth Social railed against the European Union's new fine on Google and prior penalties against U.S. tech giants Apple, Meta and Amazon.

articles.title: Amazon cracks down on use of AI images by sellers after New York law
articles.description: A recently enacted New York law mandates that companies disclose when an ad includes a "synthetic performer" in place of a human actor.
